derivation: 20 original dots form a5-column4-row unit grid. A=(0,0),B=(3,2),C=(4,3), not B=(4,2) or C=(5,3). |3*3-2*4|/2=1/2. For the auxiliary comparison cell D=(4,2), BC=sqrt2; A and D are on opposite sides of x-y=1 at distance1/sqrt2. Thus ABC and DBC each have area1/2, whereas the full one-by-one cell has area1. Only B gives1/2.
target_identity: ABC stays the single labeled original triangle; D is only an existing unlabeled grid dot. No new point is drawn.
